name: Sonarr
description: Finds and organizes TV episodes automatically.
compose:
services:
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:latest
    container_name: sonarr
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8989"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - /srv/media/tv:/tv
      - /srv/downloads:/downloads
